# v3.11.4.0, The Drift Guard Skips Compiler-Emitted Declarations

A declaration file that a TypeScript build writes no longer fails the module header rule.

> Spec folder: `specs/cli-external-orchestration/085-cli-deepseek-harness-creation/016-ci-red-check-repairs` (Level 1)

&nbsp;

## What's New at a Glance

- **Emitted declarations pass.** `verify_alignment_drift.py` skips the module header rule on a `.d.ts`, `.d.mts` or `.d.cts` file whose last line is a `//# sourceMappingURL=` comment, the mark a compiler leaves.
- **Hand-written declarations still need the header.** A declaration file without that last line is checked as before.
- **Docs match.** The TypeScript checklist and style guide name the same exception.

&nbsp;

## Upgrade

No migration required.
